evidence: Copland Track starts at a carpark beside Rough Creek, accessed from SH6 beside the bridge over Karangarua River.
Find the orange marker on the other side of Rough Creek then follow the well-formed path through the forest.
The track zigzags to its highest point, then descends through forest before emerging at Welcome Flat Hut.
Follow Copland Track back down the valley to the car park.

doubts: The car park start has no road-end feature in the packet, so start ref is null. DOC's time and distance are given 'one way', but the page's 'Return journey' section says to follow the Copland Track back down the valley to the car park, so the shape is out_and_back; the time and distance are DOC's one-way figures. The order of Palaver Creek and Open Creek follows the text's wording, and Palaver Creek is only approached ('towards'), so it is listed as a place on the way. The Rough Creek flood bridge is for exiting the valley when the creek is flooded or a tramper is trapped; the text does not say where it leads, so from is the crossing and how is 'other'.
